businesses.business: Aircraft engine leasing and aviation services

offering_description.value: Leases spare jet engines and commercial aircraft to airlines and other aviation operators. It manages aviation assets for owners, provides maintenance and teardown services, and sells used aircraft and engine parts.

primary_products.value: used aircraft engines; used commercial aircraft; serviceable engine and airframe parts

primary_services.value: aircraft engine and aircraft leasing; aviation asset management and technical consulting; engine and airframe maintenance; aircraft storage; aircraft and engine teardown

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial airlines, aircraft and engine lessors, aviation asset owners, and maintenance and repair organizations

end_markets.value: commercial passenger aviation; air cargo; aviation leasing and asset management; aviation maintenance and aftermarket parts

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: short- and long-term leases of spare engines and commercial aircraft; transaction or usage fees: lease-related maintenance payments tied to flight hours or cycles; product sales: used engines, aircraft, and serviceable components; service fees: maintenance, technical consulting, aircraft storage, and teardown; commissions or management fees: management of aircraft and engine portfolios for third-party owners
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; transaction or usage fees; product sales; service fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: acquires and manages engines and aircraft for lease to commercial aviation operators; service provider: maintains, stores, dismantles, and manages aviation assets for operators and owners; distributor: sources and recovers used components for sale to airlines and repair shops

geography_served.value: global: serves customers in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and other regions, with facilities in the United States and United Kingdom

specialization.value: related lines: engine and aircraft leasing, asset management, maintenance, teardown, and used parts sales

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: leasing, asset management, and parts sales teams serving airlines, asset owners, and repair organizations; own locations: company-operated maintenance, storage, and teardown facilities

regulatory_exposure.value: high: aircraft and engine maintenance requires repair organization approvals and airworthiness compliance under FAA and UK CAA oversight
